name: qurl
description: Share an app running on your machine privately from Codex with qURL, by email invitation, email sign-in, review, approved passkeys or contract: no deploy, no account, no API key.

interface.shortDescription: Share your local app privately: no deploy, no account
interface.longDescription: Share an app, API or site running on your machine with a person or another agent, privately, without deploying it or opening a port. No account, API key or signup. Choose who can open it: email invitations, email sign-in, review, approved passkeys or a contract with your backend. Includes the qURL agent skill and three commands: $qurl:share, $qurl:approve and $qurl:access.
defaultPrompt: Share the app I'm working on privately with qURL.
